input.pr_title: feat: add rate limiting to content submission endpoint
input.pr_description:
Adds sliding-window rate limiting to prevent spam content submissions.

## Changes
- New RateLimiter utility class with in-memory sliding window
- Rate limit dependency injected into content creation endpoint
- Returns 429 with Retry-After header when limit exceeded
- Default: 5 submissions per 60 seconds per user
input.bugged_diff:
diff --git a/app/utils/rate_limiter.py b/app/utils/rate_limiter.py
new file mode 100644
--- /dev/null
+++ b/app/utils/rate_limiter.py
@@ -0,0 +1,35 @@
+import time
+
+
+class RateLimiter:
+    def __init__(self, max_requests: int = 5, window_seconds: int = 60):
+        self.max_requests = max_requests
+        self.window_seconds = window_seconds
+        self._requests: dict[str, list[float]] = {}
+
+    def is_allowed(self, key: str) -> tuple[bool, dict]:
+        now = time.time()
+        if key not in self._requests:
+            self._requests[key] = []
+
+        # Filter expired timestamps
+        self._requests[key] = [
+            ts for ts in self._requests[key] if now - ts < self.window_seconds
+        ]
+
+        remaining = self.max_requests - len(self._requests[key])
+        if remaining > 0:
+            self._requests[key].append(now)
+            return True, {
+                "limit": self.max_requests,
+                "remaining": remaining - 1,
+                "retry_after": 0,
+            }
+        else:
+            oldest = self._requests[key][0]
+            retry_after = self.window_seconds - (now - oldest)
+            return False, {
+                "limit": self.max_requests,
+                "remaining": 0,
+                "retry_after": round(retry_after),
+            }
+

planted_defects.title: Missing Retry-After header in 429 response
planted_defects.description: The PR description states that the endpoint returns a 429 with a Retry-After header when the limit is exceeded, and RateLimiter.is_allowed() calculates retry_after in its returned info dictionary. However, create_content raises HTTPException without passing the headers parameter. The client receives a 429 status code without the Retry-After header, violating RFC 6585 and failing the stated PR requirements.
planted_defects.root_cause: The HTTPException is raised with only status_code and detail, but not headers={'Retry-After': str(info['retry_after'])}. The info dict is computed but never used.
planted_defects.suggested_fix: Pass the Retry-After header to HTTPException: raise HTTPException(status_code=429, detail='Rate limit exceeded', headers={'Retry-After': str(info['retry_after'])})

planted_defects.title: Unbounded memory leak from stale keys in _requests
planted_defects.description: When a user's request is evaluated, key is added to self._requests. Expired timestamps are filtered out, but if all timestamps expire (self._requests[key] becomes an empty list), the key is never deleted from the dictionary. Over time, as distinct user IDs hit the service, self._requests will grow indefinitely in memory, leading to memory exhaustion and potential OOM crashes.
planted_defects.root_cause: The is_allowed method filters expired timestamps but never removes dictionary keys whose timestamp lists become empty.
planted_defects.suggested_fix: Clean up keys whose timestamp lists become empty after filtering: if not self._requests[key]: del self._requests[key]
